old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-wr8j","title":"(authz) Gate GET /diag/rangetest: interval body mutates state unauthenticated","description":"AUDIT (epic 6mij decomposition): lichen_rangetest_get_handler (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_rangetest.c:765-828) has NO dispatch auth, yet it (a) MUTATES s_interval_ms from the request body (coap_rangetest.c:798-801, spec/12-apps.md 18.7.3 continuous range test) and (b) registers an RFC 7641 observer slot (coap_rangetest.c:815-823). new_value: GET /diag/rangetest no longer allows unauthenticated state mutation (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_rangetest.c:798-808): after the existing unprotect (778) and interval decode (791), an added gate fires when interval.has_interval_ms && !oscore.is_protected && !lichen_coap_is_local_admin(addr, addr_len) -> 4.01 UNAUTHORIZED via coap_oscore_respond_resource, placed BEFORE the s_interval_ms store (810) and BEFORE RFC 7641 observer registration (828), so a 4.01 consumes no observer slot. Plain unauthenticated GET with no interval body stays publicly readable per spec 18.7 (range-test readability) and spec/11-lci.md 17.6.3 Standard level (GET, Observe); spec 18.7.3 mandates no alternative policy, so no escalation needed. Gate is on has_interval_ms (the precise mutating part), not on body presence: a non-mutating body (e.g. {}) remains public. Tests (lichen/tests/coap_rangetest/src/main.c, new ZTEST get_interval_requires_authz): unauth GET with interval_ms body -> 4.01 and s_interval_ms unchanged (asserted against LICHEN_RANGETEST_DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MS); same request with Observe option -> 4.01 and observer list empty (no slot consumed); local-admin GET with body -> 2.05 and s_interval_ms==1000; OSCORE-protected GET with body -> 2.05 and s_interval_ms==1000; plain unauth GET without body -> 2.05 with interval untouched. Twister qemu_x86/atom: 1/1 configurations passed, 12/12 test cases passed (all 11 prior cases green + 1 new), outdir /Volumes/Attic/tmp/twister-rangetest-authz. Commit 8c29d5852b (fix(coap): gate rangetest GET interval mutation).
